scope: Fixed synthetic operator comparison. Spatial errors are not temporal noise estimates. Known-channel TIFF fidelity only; interpolated-channel quality is not independently scored. One-code writer tolerance is a rounding bound, not a fidelity threshold. Neutral CFA truth does not independently establish color/permutation accuracy. Negative changes favor signed on that metric; no automatic quality or calibration PASS.
